values.website: This compact, fanless edge computing system is designed for AI inference, networking, and industrial applications, combining an Intel® Core™ N350 processor with flexible expansion for AI accelerators or NVMe storage. Key differentiators include dual Gigabit LAN, multiple display outputs (up to 4K), wide OS support, and robust I/O in a small form factor. It targets edge AI deployments, smart retail, industrial automation, and network security solutions.

Industrial Machine Vision & Quality Inspection
Smart Traffic & Transportation Edge Nodes
Edge Security & Surveillance with AI Analytics
values.catalogue:
Industrial Machine Vision & Quality Inspection — The x7425E supports Intel OpenVINO for advanced AI inference, and pairs with GigE PoE+ ports with screw-lock mechanisms — ideal for securely connecting industrial cameras in machine vision applications.
Smart Traffic & Transportation Edge Nodes — The platform supports up to 3 independent 4K60 displays and up to 32 Execution Units (EU) for AI inference, making it well-suited for multi-camera traffic analytics, license plate recognition, and pedestrian counting at intersections.
Edge Security & Surveillance with AI Analytics — The platform includes onboard TPM 2.0 and hardware virtualization support, enabling secure multi-tenant edge deployments with isolated AI workloads for video analytics.
